title: Recon-first wizard flow: wizard default starts low-impact recon, then shows evidence-based assessment plan before any active scanning — expert pentester workflow
goal: Complete the adaptive workflow by wiring the recon-first path into the wizard. IMPORTANT LANGUAGE CORRECTION: nmap and httpx are NOT passive — they send active network traffic. They are LOW-IMPACT recon (no exploitation, no fuzzing, no payloads) but still create network connections to the target. The wizard must be clear about this. New wizard flow: (1) Wizard Step 2 shows two options: 'Start with quick recon (recommended, ~5 min, low-impact active recon: nmap port scan + HTTP fingerprinting)' OR 'I already know what to test (pick depth now)'. The recon option must state clearly it sends network traffic to the target. (2) Operator approves the recon step (one explicit approval for nmap + httpx). (3) Mission Control shows recon running. When complete, shows SignalProfile summary: 'Found: Apache 2.4.49 · PHP 7.2 · WordPress 5.8 · Login form at /wp-login.php · File upload at /wp-content/uploads · No JWT tokens · No GraphQL endpoint'. (4) AssessmentPlan shown (from backlog-255): RUN (7) / WAIT (5) / SKIP (11) columns. (5) Operator reviews, adjusts, approves. Only RUN items execute. This is how good pentesters work: understand the target before picking tools. The 'I know what I want' path (current depth selection) remains fully functional — no existing functionality removed.
